title: Witness Appearance Schedule for In-Person Unemployment Insurance Appeals Sessions
content:
Granted subpoena requests decide the witness appearance days of an in-person session under Unemployment Insurance Appeals.

**Schedule.** The witness appearance days are the two-subpoena appearance days when two or more subpoena requests on the appeal stand granted, the one-subpoena appearance days when exactly one does, and zero days when none does. These days are added to the room block gap, and the set hearing date is moved later by the total before the calendar-day rule is applied.

| Subpoena requests on the appeal standing granted | Witness appearance days |
|---|---|
| two or more | 4 |
| exactly one | 2 |
| none | 0 |

## What is counted

Only subpoena requests whose status is granted. A request standing received and not yet decided, or one denied, is not counted; requests of every party on the appeal count alike.

*Cases (hypothetical):* one granted and two received — 2 days; three granted — 4 days; one denied — 0 days.
